unknowns.unknown_en: Build orientation, supports, meaning of layer thickness, power, exposure/curing, cleaning liquids, washout, actual tray release and waste SOP are unreported; do not restate 75 micron as confirmed layer height
Loading mass, replenishment interface, containers and actual handling safety are unknown; do not provide real resin-handling recipes
Do not automatically inherit shaft diameter, blade thickness, outer wall or manufacturing tolerances beyond Fig1; the spectrum-sample section does not separately repeat their numerical D
Complete tube length, hole depth, sealing, clamping force, face localization and inner diameter are unknown; previous asset coordinates are authored only
SI's 7 cm belongs to numerical validation; physical four-point absolute positions, face references and unused-hole handling are incompletely specified
Amplifier model, gain, wiring/impedance topology, power supply, DS345 setting sequence, sound level and source/tube coupling are unknown
Stable phase reference for sequential single-probe sampling, synchronization, sample rate, window, repeats, calibration and trigger details are unreported
Envelope, cycle count, transmitter/receiver positions, pulse load, arrival-time estimator and trigger definition are unknown
Holder clamping/sealing, cell-number-to-experimental-axis orientation, phase zero and assembly tolerance are unknown
Material/weight of the 3 m plates, lift/support system, actual upper-plate assembly/removal path and spacers are unspecified
The source gives no coupling/adapter geometry between 40 mm speakers and the 28 mm plate gap
Probe entry into the enclosed 28 mm gap, probe-shaft/cable routing and full-scan reachability are unknown; Fig10 is not a mechanical drawing
Exact axis assignment, origin/endpoints, grid and scan speed for the 2.3 x 1.0 m area are unspecified; existing stage transforms do not establish full coverage
The source gives diameter, material and source coordinates but not height, fixation, insertion path or measured positioning tolerance
Raw waveforms and exact processing scripts are unavailable; a pressure-amplitude map is not automatically calibrated acoustic energy-flux intensity
Existing .glb files and display transforms lack physical constraints, sensors and contact/grasp/collision/reachability validation
Real cleaners, resin treatment/disposal and component-lifetime specifications are absent

hard_failures: Disassembling controlled equipment with active output or without safe_release
Replacing physical loading/unloading and records with visibility changes, teleportation or relabeling
One entity in two locations, or one record impersonating different holes/loads
Forcing the four-microphone method into 4 simultaneous physical microphones without explaining the source difference
Applying Fig1 geometry to all cells or using 4958-A as if its identity were verified

a.fig1.locator: Results / Fig. 1 configuration and example geometry
a.fig1.fact_summary_en: Four helical blades separated by 90 degrees; example D28,d6,L41,P9 mm. Field images are simulations.

a.dispersion.locator: Results / Fig. 2 effective parameters and applicability
a.dispersion.fact_summary_en: Two short samples have L/P of 12.15/7 and 13.49/7.8 mm; effective-medium approximation fails when high-frequency wavelengths approach structural scales.

a.fabrication.fact_summary_en: Somos GP Plus photosensitive resin; source manufacturing wording is laser sintering stereo-lithography, with SLA300 equipment and 75 micron resolution.

a.spectrum.fact_summary_en: Experimental transmission peaks for both short samples are approximately 4170 Hz; distinguish these from analysis and simulation.

a.pulse.fact_summary_en: Center frequency 4170 Hz; air propagation approximately 4.745 ms; additional A/B delays approximately 0.206/0.216 ms.

a.lens_design.locator: Results / Fig. 4 individual characterization of forty cells
a.lens_design.fact_summary_en: Measure transmission and phase individually for 40 cells with distinct leads/lengths at 4170 Hz.

a.lens_assembly.fact_summary_en: Assemble 40 cells into a lens exposed to a continuous normally incident plane wave.

a.field.fact_summary_en: Two 3 m x 3 m x 15 mm plates with a 28 mm gap; absorbing foam boundaries; 60 speakers of 40 mm diameter at 44 mm spacing, synchronously driven by the same signal; local-pressure scan region 2.3 m x 1.0 m.

a.obstacle.fact_summary_en: A rigid cylinder of diameter 4 cm at (z,x)=(1.211,0.175) m; panel d is an experimental demonstration with a same-size aluminum-alloy obstacle.

a.tube.fact_summary_en: DS345 and an amplifier drive the tube-end source; one quarter-inch Type4958 microphone occupies four positions; the other end is open or rubber-plug sealed; processing uses PULSE Reflex Core.

a.numerical.fact_summary_en: Pro/Engineer modeling, COMSOL4.3b acoustic-solid-coupled full-wave simulation and PML boundaries; none are executed by this task.

a.data.fact_summary_en: Supporting paper data must be requested from the authors; their original acquired waveforms are not available locally.

a.si_tube.fact_summary_en: The sample occupies 0<x<L; x1/x2 are upstream and x3/x4 downstream; two loads support transfer-matrix estimation; 7 cm spacing is reported only in the numerical-validation section.

a.si_lens.fact_summary_en: Insert cells into the holder by number; adjacent centers are 6 cm apart.

a.si_scan.fact_summary_en: Only part of the main lobe was scanned because of translation-stage limits.

a.si_table.fact_summary_en: Retain leads, lengths and effective parameters for cells 1 through 40 row by row; do not replace them with Fig1 geometry.

a.si_limits.fact_summary_en: Label effective-medium theory, loss, structural rigidity, neighboring coupling and derivations separately; the page 7 caption mistakenly repeats figure number 6, so locate it by page and content.
